Cliff sand

A separate ground paint, usable on flat ground or raised terrain. The soft edge contains sand and transparency, so the local ground supplies its own colour. Both sprites are 512 × 512 pixels for a 2-unit tile.

The solid tile repeats without rotation. The feathered sprite is a standalone patch; broad sand areas use the solid tile with a painted transition at the boundary.
